transport_binding: not installed on NAMA2I01; offline C++ engine accepts this binary
runtime_rules: Configure only while DSP is stopped and access serialized. Invalid program leaves previous chain intact.
Unused built-in parameters are zero; all parameters finite and within effect catalog limits.
Stateful effects have one instance per type. Gain, overdrive and distortion may repeat.
Serial routing only. Split/merge, stereo paths and arbitrary feedback graphs require a future graph scheduler.
CRC32 detects transport corruption, not authorship or authorization.
